text.tspan: Whisper Village at twilight — a ward stone at the border fading
from gentle pulse to dark stone. Mist creeping from Wild Woods
beyond. One ward stone dark, others glowing warm. Silhouette of
something large and wobbling at tree line. Ominous but not
terrifying — dreamy pastel tension. dreamy pastel children's
book illustration, soft blush and mint palette, whisper-thin
rounded lines, golden-hour glow with floating magic motes,
ethereal gradients, hand-painted paper texture, cozy whimsical
mood, no text. palette: cream #fdf6e3, blush-pink #f4c2c2, mint-
lavender #6b5b95. leave the lower third as calm, low-detail
negative space for caption text; keep characters clear of that
